title: Nathan Williams's periodicity conjecture for trapezoids
statement:
Let $p$ be an integer with $p>1$, let $s\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $P$ be the subposet

$$
\{(i,k)\in[p]\times[p]\mid i+k>p+1\text{ and }i\leq k\text{ and }k\geq s\}
$$

of $[p]\times[p]$. Let $f\in\mathbb{K}^{\widehat{P}}$ be a $\mathbb{K}$-labeling such that $R^pf\neq\operatorname{\bot}$, and set $a=f(0)$ and $b=f(1)$. **Nathan Williams's trapezoid periodicity conjecture.** The elements $a$ and $b$ are invertible, and for every $x\in\widehat{P}$,

$$
(R^pf)(x)=a\overline{b}\cdot f(x)\cdot\overline{a}b.
$$

This is presented as a noncommutative extension of Nathan Williams's conjecture in the commutative setting; the supplied text does not state a resolution.
source_name: Darij Grinberg and Tom Roby, “Birational rowmotion on a rectangle over a noncommutative ring”, arXiv:2208.11156 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.11156

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2022).
